title: Maximum Vacation Days
statement: Given a singly linked list and an integer `k`, rotate the linked list to the right by `k` places. The rotation should be performed in a circular manner, meaning that if the list has `n` nodes and `k` is greater than `n`, the list should be rotated by `k % n` places. For example, if the list is `1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 -> 5` and `k` is `2`, the rotated list should be `4 -> 5 -> 1 -> 2 -> 3`. Your task is to write a function that takes the head of the linked list and the integer `k` as input and returns the head of the rotated linked list.
